component.name: LinGHub
component.summary: Profile manager for the Logitech G502 family

description.p: LinGHub edits named profiles for the Logitech G502 family — button bindings, DPI table, LED settings and report rate — and loads the right one into the mouse when a game starts.
It talks to ratbagd over the system D-Bus and writes every binding to the mouse's own memory, so games see real hardware events rather than synthetic ones.
